title: gate_approves_spend still approves an answer worded Won't spend, Cannot approve, Do nothing or Dont spend, which the sprint's refusal words leave out
goal: gate_approves_spend treats an answer that opens with a contraction of a refusal (won't, can't, cannot, don't without the apostrophe) or with do nothing as a refusal

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch as d;g=lambda a:{"question":"Approve spend?","options":["yes",a],"answer":a};bad=[a for a in ("Won\x27t spend","Cannot approve","Do nothing","Dont spend") if d.gate_approves_spend(g(a))];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
